achievements.name: Galar Starter
achievements.detail: Choose Grookey, Scorbunny, or Sobble when Leon offers you a partner in Postwick.

achievements.name: First Catch
achievements.detail: Catch a wild Pokémon in a Poké Ball.

achievements.name: Pokédex
achievements.detail: Receive the Pokédex that Sonia gives you.

achievements.name: Grass Badge
achievements.detail: Beat Milo at Turffield Stadium and take the Grass Badge.

achievements.name: Dynamax
achievements.detail: Dynamax one of your Pokémon in a battle.

achievements.name: Wild Area
achievements.detail: Catch a Pokémon while exploring the Wild Area.

achievements.name: Max Raid
achievements.detail: Win a Max Raid Battle at a den in the Wild Area.

achievements.name: Ghost Badge
achievements.detail: Defeat Allister in Stow-on-Side and earn the Ghost Badge.

achievements.name: Ice Badge
achievements.detail: Defeat Melony in Circhester and earn the Ice Badge.

achievements.name: Eight Badges
achievements.detail: Collect all eight Badges of the Galar Gym Challenge.

achievements.name: Zamazenta
achievements.detail: Catch Zamazenta, Shield's legendary Pokémon, in the post-game.

achievements.name: Galar Champion
achievements.detail: Defeat Leon and become Champion of the Galar region.
